Being small and bold, I snuck up to the front of the bandstand where RFK was speaking- I don't remember what he said, but the tears and hyperventilating of the crowds carried me away, and, as Bobby Kennedy went past, I like many others, reached out and grabbed at the hem of his pants... I really understand about crowd hysteria, like the Beatles or Elvis, how people lose themselves- and why stars and politicians need protection from crowds.

My aunt being sick and eventually passing away.
